implementationStatus: The candidate components exist, but no Scheduler-driven Extension has yet exercised model-operation/v3, host-authorized delivered Media, the production ChatModelBroker, the production Node transport, strict SSE, and atomic Module-result commit in one live run. Public Module startup remains refused.
question: Can one Scheduler-claimed Block containing text and one local PNG Media reference drive a real isolated Extension through model-operation/v3 and Dolly's production ChatModelBroker to the owner's Aether qwen3.6-27b deployment using one strict streaming request, return the exact fixed image answer, atomically commit one output Block, close the Claim, Media lease, model-effect journal, secret lease, and child process, while keeping the public Module startup refusal intact?

hypotheses.candidate: All registered gates pass in one run.
hypotheses.alternative: At least one gate fails or cannot be independently reconstructed; the composition remains inconclusive or rejected at that exact boundary.

baselines.evidence: model-broker-inline-media-live-v0 version 2 obtained the exact answer through ChatModelBroker and NodeModelHttpTransport, but started zero Module processes and did not test Scheduler, model-operation, or atomic result commit.
The installed Linux integration drives real Extension processes through Scheduler and model-operation, but its model broker is deterministic and text-only; it is not live provider or image evidence.
A request that drops the image, becomes non-streaming, adds enable_thinking, retries, or reaches the provider outside model-operation/v3 is a failing baseline, not a partial success.

data.fixture: One deterministic locally generated 640x360 PNG with a public exact answer key, plus the fixed IMAGE_TASK_PROMPT in the same immutable dolly.content/1 Block.
data.reasonForOneRepetition: This is a paid vertical integration canary, not an efficacy or reliability estimate. One pass can prove reachability and falsify boundary claims but cannot support generalization.

modelAndBackend.endpoint: Owner-configured AETHER_BASE_URL, omitted from every artifact.
modelAndBackend.credential: Owner-configured AETHER_API_KEY, retained only in the parent process and omitted from every artifact and Extension environment.
modelAndBackend.descriptor: dolly.model-descriptor/4 with exact inline PNG, json_object, request-controlled thinking-object, and strict SSE strategies.
modelAndBackend.thinking: thinking.type is disabled; enable_thinking is forbidden. Non-empty reasoning_content would contradict this fixture profile and fail the gate.
modelAndBackend.gatewayContext: The owner reports that the former Nginx 120-second timeout was corrected to 24 hours before this registration. Dolly still enforces its independent 30-minute per-call bound.

order: register the exact PNG in persistent FileCore Media
start Scheduler and one isolated Extension process
append one input Block and let Scheduler create the active Claim
let model-operation/v3 forward only the delivered Media reference
let the Host-only resolver re-authorize the same active Claim and copy the PNG
dispatch one production Node transport strict-SSE request
atomically commit one Module output and acknowledge the input Claim
stop the exact recorded child and persist its stopped record
write sanitized artifacts and run the independent verifier
execution.scopeNote: The live canary uses the candidate Scheduler/Extension-process composition. Separate systemd-container evidence proves the installed Linux cgroup path; this run must not merge those two evidence claims.

minimumEffectiveDifference: The candidate differs materially from both baselines only if every gate is exact: one and only one strict-SSE provider dispatch, capability version v3, exact fixed image answer, one committed Module result, zero active Claims and dead letters, zero Media leases and provider-access records, terminal effect evidence after reopening, one secret release, no credential in the child, and no live child after stop. There is no partial percentage threshold.
gates: The product request has stream=true, stream_options.include_usage=true, thinking.type=disabled, no enable_thinking, response_format=json_object, and one inline PNG data URL constructed by the Host.
The Extension sees model-operation/v3 and never sees endpoint, key, local path, URL, Base64 image bytes, access mode, placement strategy, or resolver result.
The strict SSE decoder receives HTTP 200 text/event-stream, at least one bounded chunk, one terminal completion, and finish_reason=stop.
The public answer equals the deterministic image answer key exactly and reasoning state is not-observed.
FileCore records one committed result, zero pending input, one pending sink output, zero active Claims, and zero dead letters.
Media has zero provider-access records and zero remaining leases after the broker returns.
The model effect is terminal both before and after reopening the file journal; the secret lease releases exactly once.
The exact recorded child is alive before orderly stop, absent after stop, and its process record is stopped.
The artifacts contain neither the private endpoint nor credential, and runtime-bootstrap still contains RUNTIME_MODULE_MIGRATION_REQUIRED.

stoppingRules.beforeNetwork: Abort before dispatch on any source hash mismatch, missing opt-in, invalid endpoint, missing credential, Media inspection failure, capability construction failure, or Extension startup failure.
stoppingRules.duringRun: Make no retry. Any provider, SSE, model, capability, Scheduler, result-commit, Media, effect, or process-lifecycle failure stops the run and retains its exact scratch directory when termination is not confirmed.
stoppingRules.efficacy: Do not stop based on a partial answer. Evaluate only the one complete terminal call.
stoppingRules.budget: Stop at one logical call, one provider attempt, or the 1800000 millisecond model wall-time bound. The case observer allows an additional 30000 milliseconds for cancellation and terminal propagation.

decisionRules.ifPassed: Keep model-operation/v3 plus the Host-only delivered-reference resolver as the next reversible general-Agent image input slice. This is component integration evidence, not public Module support, broad model compatibility, or a vision benchmark.
decisionRules.ifRejected: Classify the first exact failing boundary, change that boundary only, increment the preregistration version, and repeat no call under this frozen version.
prohibitedClaims: Do not claim Linux cgroup ownership from this run; that has separate systemd-container evidence.
Do not claim URL, OSS, crop, JPEG, provider upload, native tool calling, automatic retry, or public Module activation.
Do not generalize from one deterministic image or from the owner's private deployment.
Do not treat HTTP acceptance, model text without the exact answer, or a committed Block without closed effects and leases as success.

artifacts.privacy: Artifacts contain public fixture output, hashes, sizes, status enums, usage-independent wire booleans, and journal metadata. They omit endpoint, credential, authorization header, image bytes, data URL, raw provider stream, and provider reasoning text.

checks: Recompute preregistration, implementation, result, and effect-journal hashes.
Require exact answer, capability v3, strict SSE, disabled thinking, no reasoning, and exactly one provider dispatch.
Require committed Scheduler, Claim, Media, effect, secret, and process terminal states.
Read runtime-bootstrap source and require the Module startup refusal marker.
Reject either exact private endpoint or key value in any recorded artifact.
